svg.title: Design sheet · Collarbone necklace and wings
svg.text: Design sheet · Collarbone necklace and wings
Front view. The chain follows the collarbones, the pendant sits on the center line, the wings fan over the shoulder caps. Lesson 10.3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Order: guide dots, chain and drops, pendant, wings, white highlights and dots. Keep it above the neckline.
